title: Northstar Incident Runbook
subtitle: Revision 1 | Fictional demonstration material
sections: This runbook defines the first response for a production service incident at Northstar Field Services. The incident lead records the timeline and coordinates responders.

For a critical incident, the on-call engineer opens an incident channel immediately. The incident lead notifies the Security on-call within 30 minutes of confirming the incident. The service owner provides a customer impact estimate and a next update time.
The initial restoration objective for a critical service is four hours from incident declaration. Responders must preserve relevant logs and record any emergency change in the incident timeline.
Vendor-hosted data incidents also use the Northstar Vendor Operations Guide. The guide is separate controlled material and must be consulted for vendor bridge steps.
